يتكون نظام الاطفاء الذاتى بغاز 
 CO2 من عدد من الاسطوانات يوجد بداخلها غاز ثانى اكسيد 
 الكربون فى حالته السائلة تحت ضغط 80 بار تقريبا كما يتم وضع هذه الاسطوانات فى 
 مجموعات طبقا لكمية الغاز المطلوبة للاطفاء وتكون كل مجموعة من هذه المجموعات 
 مخصصة لاطفاء الحريق فى منطقة محددة تتناسب مع حجم الغاز داخل هذه الاسطوانات 
 ويوجد رشاشات لغاز الاطفاء ومكتشفات لهب موزعة كما بالجدول التالى:-

وكل من مكتشفات اللهب 
والحرارة لهما خطين غير معتمدين على بعضهما ولكى يعمل نظام الحريق لا بد ان تاتى 
اشارة انذار بوجود حريق من احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الاول 
مقترنة بانذار على 
احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الثانى فان سولونيد تحرير الاوزان يتحرك فيعمل نظام 
الحريق وفى نفس الوقت تذهب اشارات الخروج الاضطرارى 
Trip من مفتاح
limit switch الى مختلف مكونات الوحدة لكى تتوقف 
وعند عمل النظام او عند 
الاختبار يتم اعادة وضع حامل الاسطوانات الى وضع التشغيل

Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for resetting the cylinder holder of the CO2 fire extinguishing system for the gas unit.

The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:

Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signals go from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop. When the system operates or is tested, the cylinder holder is reset to the operating position.

This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.

Carefully place the cap arms G on the cylinder valves

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Fire Protection Systems | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-044-R0A | Equipment: Automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system for the Siemens VZ2 gas unit, Preussag – Minimax
Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 28 May 2008 | Procedure: Resetting the cylinder holder
Date of next review: May 2013
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for resetting the cylinder holder of the CO2 fire extinguishing system for the gas unit.
The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:
Flame detector | Heat detector | Nozzles | Number of cylinders | 
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Right combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Left combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 8 | 7 | Oil tank
Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signals go from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop. When the system operates or is tested, the cylinder holder is reset to the operating position.
This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order by the Occupational Safety and Health Department | 
Wear personal protective equipment | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Set of screwdrivers | 
Pliers | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
Make sure the weight-release box is reset | 1.
Place weights A on the carrier arm B | 2.
Raise the weight-carrying arm B and hang it on the drop arm D | 3
Make sure the pull hoist E is fixed to the cylinder-opening arm F | 4
Carefully place the cap arms G on the cylinder valves | 5
Raise the valve locking pins, if any | 6
